messages:
Ari: Drafting a 360-feedback micro-template for managers to use during calibration and 1:1s. Want ultra-short pasteables so peers actually leave feedback. Thoughts?

Bree: Love the idea. Can we make distinct variants: peer-to-peer, upward, and downward feedback? Keep each to 1-2 lines.

Kofi: Also include a one-line anonymity option and an example for mentoring feedback.

people-ops-bot: Saved to /templates/feedback/360-micro-tiles  public

Ari: Pasteables  pick the one that fits and paste into the form: 
- Peer-to-peer (1 line): "Gives clear context in PR comments; reduced rework and sped merges."
- Peer-to-peer (2 lines, BEI): "Behavior: asks clarifying Qs in design reviews. Evidence: blocked ambiguous work reduced by 30%. Impact: smoother sprints; suggestion: pair on two specs to spread the pattern."
- Upward feedback (1 line): "Appreciate clearer priorities this quarter; helped my roadmap planning."
- Upward feedback (1 line, ask): "Request: earlier heads-up on scope changes would help planning."
- Downward feedback (manager to IC, 1 line): "Clear goals and weekly check-ins helped me prioritize; one ask: more async decision notes."
- Mentoring feedback (1 line): "Provided practical debugging tips during onboarding; new hire ramped 2 weeks faster."
- Anonymous cross-team blurb (1 line): "Anon note: more timely review lanes for infra PRs would help."

Bree: Can we add a short 'avoid' line?

Ari: Added: "What to avoid (1L): avoid personality judgments; focus on observable behavior and specific impact."

Kofi: Nice. Also add a one-line calibration cue for managers: if >2 peers call out the same behavior, consider elevating in calibration.

Ari: Done. Calibration cue (1L): "If 2+ peers note the same behavior, consider elevating to 'team collaboration' highlight and discuss variance in calibration."

Bree: Can people-ops pin and send a short note to leads with an example?

people-ops-bot: Pinned in #people-ops and scheduled broadcast to leads for Thursday 10am PT.

Ari: Thanks all  planning a 10-min demo in the leads sync next Tues. If no objections I'll add these to the one-pager.
